analysis.ocr_text:
FIELD TRIP CONSENT FORM

I, _________________________ (as parent/guardian), give permission to my child/ward to participate in a planned field trip activity.

TRIP DESTINATION: _________________________
DATE: ____________ TO ____________
DEPARTURE TIME: ____________
RETURN TIME: ____________

Transportation will be provided by ______ school bus.

(Signature of Parent/Guardian)

(Date of Signature)

(Addressee)

By granting this permission, I assume full responsibility for any damage to personal property caused by my child or ward. Further, I hereby expressly waive any claim for financial compensation from the Board of Education, Shrews Creek Community Schools, their employees, agents, or representatives. I further expressly agree that in the event of any action, at the discretion of the sponsor(s), my child or ward may be returned home at my expense.

(Telephone Number)
analysis.summary: The image displays a 'Field Trip Consent Form' for a student to participate in a planned activity. It includes fields for trip details, a liability waiver, and a section for the parent or guardian to sign.
